sys_script.description: Thin adapter: when an extraction's disposition transitions to Applied (confirmed), gather the GUIDELINE allow-list snapshot diff against the superseded extraction (if any) and delegate to UWTriggerReasonResolver + UWGuidelineVersionService to create the next uw_guideline_version header for every submission_line on the submission. No scoring logic lives here.
sys_script.name: UW Guideline trigger on extraction confirmed
